title: Mother's Day at Flinders Hotel
summary: A family-shaped Mother's Day booking in Flinders: lunch from 10:30am with live jazz, face painting and a raffle gift hamper built into the day.
description: Flinders Hotel is running a Mother's Day event on Sunday 10 May 2026 from 10:30am. The draw is not just the meal — live jazz, face painting and a raffle gift hamper give the day enough structure to keep mixed-age family groups happy without overcomplicating it.
suitableFor: Families; mixed-age groups; visitors staying on the southern Peninsula
verificationStatus: Direct lead supplied in active editorial review thread
kidsGradeNote: One of the more forgiving Mother's Day bookings for kids because the entertainment is built in rather than left to the adults to improvise.
editorVerdict: The strongest all-round Mother's Day booking on the Peninsula this Sunday if the brief is family lunch without the day going flat.
editorNote: Flinders Hotel is the Mother's Day booking with the most useful built-in shape. Live jazz makes the room feel like an occasion, face painting handles the youngest table members, and the raffle/gift-hamper layer gives the day just enough theatre without tipping into novelty. If you want one booking that can carry the whole family through to mid-afternoon, this is the cleanest version.
